visual_direction: Full-width illustrated situation, neutral-number mystery, actual interface, progressive evidence reveal, human handover. Composition follows the story instead of repeating a slide template.

scenes.title: Would you approve it?
scenes.narration: Nora has a repaired analysis to review. Would you approve it?

scenes.title: Two patches. Same total.
scenes.narration: Two patches. Same total. One is wrong.

scenes.title: Check the evidence.
scenes.narration: This repair returns the expected total. But watch what happens when we check the evidence.

scenes.title: The evidence does not match.
scenes.narration: Every pair is different. The headline matches. The evidence does not. A total-only check would miss this wrong repair.

scenes.title: Same total. Different verdict.
scenes.narration: Now the declared repair. Same total again. This time, all four pairs agree.

scenes.title: The code passed. The claim did not.
scenes.narration: The code passed. The original three point four zero claim did not. Those are separate decisions.

scenes.title: A bounded model proposal.
scenes.narration: Given the declared channel convention, NVIDIA Nemotron on Nebius Token Factory proposed two parameter arrays. It translated the convention; it did not discover it. Counts and tests stayed protected.

scenes.title: One recorded real operation.
scenes.narration: One recorded Nebius Sandbox operation tested all three variants. The repair passed. Both controls failed as expected. Guest networking was disabled.

scenes.title: Missing evidence needs review.
scenes.narration: When evidence is missing, LabRepair asks for review. It does not fill the gap with a confident answer. This is a curated local control.

scenes.title: Keep the decision inspectable.
scenes.narration: Nora records a hold against this exact source. Her decision preserves the checks and reasons. It launches no new job. The evidence receipt is ready for the next reviewer.

scenes.title: What changed. What failed. What remains.
scenes.narration: She can hand over what changed, what failed, and what still needs evidence. One synthetic case, with recorded real generation and isolated execution.

scenes.title: Repair the analysis. Preserve the evidence.
scenes.narration: LabRepair. Repair the analysis. Preserve the evidence.
